implemented: Read-only owner resource projection uses runtime tenant-only dependency/entitlement graph for exact current availability.
Distinguishes available, formal offline, local disable, source unavailable, absent entitlement, future start, expiry and blocked dependencies.
Independent entitlement kind, start and expiry columns distinguish baseline, structural/custom resources, timed and unlimited balances. Availability never implies an ordinary user grant.

Bounded page/ancestor scalar reads; no global catalog fallback, no per-row SQL and no per-page browser sorting. Display-only columns reject unsupported server filter/sort; derived field annotations preserve source field protection.
Standard SimpleTable, semantic StatusTag and shared timestamp formatting; no extra persistence/schema version added.
